layers.title: Water depth in mapped Everglades marsh
layers.summary: The daily USGS depth model gives at least 10 cm of water in 859 evaluated 400 m cells inside National Wetlands Inventory emergent marsh. 132 shallow-depth cells have an uncertain edge. The separate one-date radar benchmark agreed on 782 of the water cells and withheld 405 cells overall. The model and radar were compared within one scene at 400 m spacing. Fine shorelines are unresolved.

classes.label: Radar and modeled water agree in mapped marsh
